latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Copywriter Generator — Generate Video Scripts and Copy

- Instantly generate video ad scripts and voiceover copy for marketing with a simple text brief.
- Upload MP4, MOV, TXT, or DOCX files up to 200MB; AI processes and generates persuasive video copy in 20-40 seconds.
- Supports cloud-based rendering for fully automated video exports (up to 1080p MP4).
- Manages sessions, handles anonymous authentication, and tracks credits for free and registered users.
- Error handling and intuitive status updates for uploads, exports, and API calls.
- Designed for marketers and creators who want high-quality video copy without professional editing knowledge.
